info.name: Azure Monitor Action Groups Query API
Azure Monitor Execute an Application Insights query via GET

params.name: appId
params.description: ID of the Application Insights component. This is the Application ID from the API Access settings blade in the Azure portal.

params.name: query
params.description: The Analytics query in KQL format.

params.name: timespan
params.description: The timespan over which to query data in ISO 8601 duration format.

items.docs: Executes an Analytics query against Application Insights data using Kusto Query Language (KQL). The query is provided as a query parameter.

info.name: Azure Monitor Execute an Application Insights query via POST

params.name: appId
params.description: ID of the Application Insights component. This is the Application ID from the API Access settings blade in the Azure portal.

items.docs: Executes an Analytics query against Application Insights data using Kusto Query Language (KQL). The query is provided in the request body.

info.name: Azure Monitor Execute a Log Analytics query via GET

params.name: workspaceId
params.description: ID of the workspace. This is the Workspace ID from the Properties blade in the Azure portal.

params.name: query
params.description: The Analytics query in KQL format.

params.name: timespan
params.description: The timespan over which to query data in ISO 8601 duration format.

items.docs: Executes an Analytics query for data from a Log Analytics workspace using Kusto Query Language (KQL). The query is provided as a query parameter.

info.name: Azure Monitor Execute a Log Analytics query via POST

params.name: workspaceId
params.description: ID of the workspace. This is the Workspace ID from the Properties blade in the Azure portal.

items.docs: Executes an Analytics query for data from a Log Analytics workspace using Kusto Query Language (KQL). The query is provided in the request body along with optional parameters.
